LICENSE-webview.txt MIT, (c) 2017 Serge Zaitsev, (c) 2022 Steffen André Langnes: the webview/webview project, whose
                    built-in loader (core/include/webview/detail/platform/windows/webview2/loader.hh) is what
                    windows/web/webview2_loader.cpp is ported from.

No binary is kept here and none is shipped: WebView2Loader.dll is not used (windows/web/webview2_loader.cpp finds the
installed Evergreen runtime and calls its EmbeddedBrowserWebView.dll itself), and the runtime is Windows' own.

Updating: download https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/Microsoft.Web.WebView2 (a zip), replace WebView2.h, LICENSE.txt
and NOTICE.txt, change the version above, run windows/web-test/build.ps1.
